Spot: 4WF-4-WAY-3--061. Hero MP, AcJd, flop Qc9h3s, 4-way 3-bet pot (MP was 3-bettor), facing_bet=0, pot=28bb. Hero OOP-early with 3 villains behind. FACING_BET=0: BET or CHECK only.

Per-villain range chains: UTG cold-flatted hero's 3-bet — range-capped at TT-88/AQs/suited broadway/suited connectors; no AA/KK/AK (would 4-bet). On Q-9-3 UTG continues with Q-x combos (QJs, KQs possible in flat range), TT overpair, 99 middle set, straight draws (87s, J8s). CO cold-flatted 3-bet: range JJ-88/AQs/suited connectors; Q-9-3 hits CO well (QJ, 99, straight draws). SB cold-flatted OOP: range JJ-77/suited connectors/ATs; Q-9-3 gives SB 99 set, QJ, 87s straight draws. All three villain cold-callers have substantial continuing ranges on Q-high board.

Equity and range tensions: Hero AcJd has no pair, no live draw beyond 6 overcard outs (A, J to top pair/second pair). Hero 3-bet range c-bet frequency on Q-high boards should be range-balanced — QQ/AA/KK (value) + some AK air bluffs c-bet; AJ is in the check portion of range to balance hero's checking range (needed to protect against check-raises and to preserve QQ/AA slow-plays). 4-way pot equity realization at 0.75 reduces AJ's thin equity further. Hero has ~28% raw equity but realization is sharply cut by 3 active villains.

Spot-specific factors: Hero OOP-early, 3 villains behind can counter-attack. Leading with AJ (air) into Q-9-3 in a 28bb 4-way 3-bet pot risks: UTG 3-bet-flat range calling with TT/Q-x; CO calling or raising with 99/QJ; SB calling or raising with their continuing range. Hero cannot comfortably continue vs a raise with AcJd (no pair, no draw). Donk-lead OOP with no equity announces range weakness in this pot-size scenario. Checking protects hero's range — AJ checks alongside QQ slow-plays and mixed KK/AA, making the checking range balanced and non-exploitable.

Decision: CHECK. Bucket is 4-way-3-bet-pot-OOP-air-check. AJ as air in 3-bettor's OOP range should check on Q-high board in 4-way 3-bet pot — hero's checking range needs protection and AJ has no equity to justify the risk of being raised off the pot. If CO or SB checks and UTG c-bets, hero can fold cleanly.

Adjacent alternatives: BET 66% (~18bb) would be a high-risk bluff with no equity backup — three villain cold-callers have Q-x/sets/draws that will not fold and will raise hero off the pot. BET 25% small probe also fails — hero has no draw to fall back on and cannot continue vs a raise.
